title: Configuration Hunt
description: A production service is failing, but its configuration file is buried somewhere in this archive.
mission: Find config.production.toml and write its relative path into answer.txt.
success: You found the production configuration file.

lesson.what_happened: Recursive name-based search found the deeply nested configuration.
lesson.be_careful: Quote wildcard patterns so the shell does not expand them too early.

hints: Search recursively rather than opening every directory.
find accepts a starting directory and a name pattern.

ja.title: 設定file探索
ja.description: production設定fileがarchiveの深い場所にあります。
ja.mission: config.production.tomlを探しrelative pathをanswer.txtへ書いてください。
hints: 各directoryを手作業で開かずrecursiveに探します。
